title: Not Married Yet, Already Us
hook:
We’re not married yet.
But try telling that to our habits.
obstacle: A real shared problem and a proper fight must not disappear merely because the story is romantic.
proof_engine: Automatic habit relay -> snapped-key incident -> shared diagnosis -> equal disagreement -> interrupted exit -> clipped key return -> tissue handoff -> separate trajectories -> repaired routine.
bridge: Anger remains visible while practical concern still gets through.
relationship_motion: Both partners create the story: Zuv begins the mishap, Aachu joins the repair, both disagree, Aachu checks the injury, and their mutual routine resumes.
payoff:
Shaadi abhi baaki hai.
Par “hum” toh kab ke ban chuke hain.
send_save_reason: A viewer can send it to one person with: this is us—we fight properly and still make sure the other is okay.
